goal_template: Construct and initialize an immersive character persona: {{user_instructions}}
scratchpad_checklist: Load or initialize persona record via PersonaModule.load_persona
Write rich initialization profile (>=800 characters) with structured headings via PersonaModule.write_initialization
Finalize persona profile with in-character greeting and tagline via PersonaModule.finalize_persona

post_llm_validation_hook.on_failure_instruction: Persona verification failed. Ensure you have written initialization.md with at least 800 characters of rich lore, structured markdown headings, no generic assistant leakage, and called PersonaModule.finalize_persona with an in-character greeting before completing.
